bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "SELECT p.message_thread_id,p.message_id,p.state,p.pinned,length(p.token_hash),m.state AS migration_state FROM topic_dm_entry_pins p JOIN startless_public_post_migrations m ON m.kind=\x27topic\x27 AND m.chat_id=p.chat_id AND m.message_id=p.message_id WHERE p.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND p.message_thread_id IN (102,104,116,1000,81,92,103,50,51,52) ORDER BY p.message_thread_id;"'
echo OLD_LINK_SOURCE_AND_MIGRATION_READBACK_DONE
